Short Information : Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL) has released the Notification for the post of Assistant Lineman (NAC). This recruitment has been issued for 3289 posts. Applications for the PSPCL Assistant Lineman (NAC) Recruitment 2026 has Started from 15 June 2026, & Candidate can apply till 06 July 2026.  Candidates must check the complete details for PSPCL Assistant Lineman (NAC) Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

PSPCL ALM Advt No. : CRA 317/26

PSPCL Assistant Lineman Bharti (NAC) 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Educational Qualification – Candidates who have passed their 10th Matriculation Level of Examination along with having ITI (NAC) Apprenticeship Certification in Lineman trade will be eligible for this post
  • Work Experience – Applicants having work experience in Electrical/Wireman Trade from any registered factory/registered company/registered institute /designated as A Class Contractor will be eligible for this post.
  • Language Knowledge – Candidates who have passed their 10th Matriculation or Higher Standards with Punjabi as a Subject & having Punjabi Language Knowledge in terms of Reading, Speaking & Writing will be eligible for this recruitment.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.
